title: A Thousand Years
description: 《A Thousand Years》描寫一份跨越時間、充滿等待與永恆承諾的真摯愛情。歌中的主角曾經害怕受傷，不敢輕易敞開心扉，但當她遇見心愛的人，內心的恐懼與疑慮便逐漸消失。她相信兩人的相遇是命中注定，即使經歷漫長的等待，也始終沒有放棄尋找對方。歌曲以「一千年」象徵愛情的永恆，表達無論時間如何流逝，都願意堅定地守護這份感情。最終，《A Thousand Years》傳達的是愛情中的勇氣、信念與承諾：真正深厚的愛能克服恐懼與等待，即使歲月變遷，依然願意相伴一生，永不分離。

vocabulary.usage: 緊張、興奮或運動後心跳變快時使用。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「Heart beats fast」？
options: My heart beats fast to the supermarket every Sunday.
My heart beats fast before every driving lesson.
I put my heart beats fast in the fridge.
The chair heart beats fast when I sit down.
vocabulary.explanation: heart beats fast 描述心跳加速；學開車前緊張符合情境。
optionExplanations: 錯誤：心不能「去超市」；要說 I go to the supermarket。
heart beats fast 描述心跳加速；學開車前緊張符合情境。
錯誤：這是描述心跳的句子，不是一樣能放進冰箱的東西。
錯誤：椅子沒有心跳；這個片語用在有心跳的人或動物身上。

vocabulary.usage: 害怕時仍願意嘗試或面對困難時使用。
options: Be brave. Your first driving lesson has only one student!
I brave my ticket before I get on the train.
We are brave the window every morning.
He is brave at seven dollars.
vocabulary.explanation: be brave 鼓勵人勇敢；這裡打趣學車時無須面對一大群人。
optionExplanations: be brave 鼓勵人勇敢；這裡打趣學車時無須面對一大群人。
這裡要表達出示車票，應說 show my ticket。
錯誤：be brave 不能直接接 window 當作動作；開窗要用 open。
錯誤：勇敢不能用價錢來表示；七美元不是勇敢的程度。

vocabulary.usage: 擔心或害怕去做某個動作；後面接動詞原形。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「Be afraid to」？
options: I am afraid to my first job interview.
He is afraid to ask the teacher a question.
She afraid to go home yesterday.
They are afraid to happy today.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：be afraid to + 動詞，表示害怕做某事。
optionExplanations: to 後面缺少動詞；可說 afraid to attend。
正確：be afraid to + 動詞，表示害怕做某事。
錯誤：少了 be 動詞；應說 She was afraid to go home。
錯誤：happy 是形容詞；要說 afraid to be happy。

vocabulary.usage: 人離開某地，或疼痛、煩惱等消失時使用。
options: The red bag is go away on the table.
I go away my email with a new password.
She goes away a new dress for the party.
The rain went away, and we went outside.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：這裡用 go away 表示雨停了、雨雲離開了。
optionExplanations: 錯誤：is go away 結構不正確；要描述袋子不見了可說 The bag is gone。
登入郵箱應用 log in；go away 表示離開。
這裡想表達穿裙子，應用 wears。
正確：這裡用 go away 表示雨停了、雨雲離開了。

vocabulary.meaning: 又靠近一步；離目標更近一步
vocabulary.usage: 朝目標有一點進展，或真的往某個地方靠近一步時使用。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「One step closer」？
options: One more lesson! We're one step closer to the show.
I paid one step closer for the concert ticket.
The bus is one step closer than tomorrow is late.
She bought one step closer at the shop.
vocabulary.explanation: one step closer 表示向目標再接近一步。
optionExplanations: one step closer 表示向目標再接近一步。
one step closer 表示更接近目標，不能當票價。
比較的對象和句子結構不成立，無法表達接近目標。
錯誤：它不是可以在商店購買的物品。

vocabulary.usage: 拍照、排隊或需要暫時不要移動時使用。
options: He stands still his new password every week.
We stand still the bus to school.
Please stand still while I take your photo.
My phone stands still because it wants a holiday.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：拍照時請對方站好不要動。
optionExplanations: 更改密碼應用 changes；stand still 表示站著不動。
錯誤：坐公車應說 take the bus；stand still 不表示交通方式。
正確：拍照時請對方站好不要動。
stand still 通常描述人停止走動；這裡也無法解釋手機的狀態。

vocabulary.usage: 把東西從原來的位置移開，或把某人的東西拿走時使用。
options: She takes away very happy today.
I take away to English class at nine.
Please take away these empty cups.
The sky takes away blue every summer.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：請把空杯子收走，符合 take away 的用法。
optionExplanations: 錯誤：take away 不是描述心情；要說 She is very happy。
錯誤：take away 不能表示「去上課」；應說 go to English class。
正確：請把空杯子收走，符合 take away 的用法。
錯誤：take away 需要合理的被拿走事物；這句語意不通。

vocabulary.usage: 說明人或物所在的位置；後面通常接名詞。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「In front of」？
options: I in front of my train ticket every morning.
Dad stands in front of the TV and misses his own goal.
We are in front of happy at school.
She drinks in front of yesterday.
vocabulary.explanation: in front of 表示在前面；爸爸擋住了自己的視線。
optionExplanations: in front of 是位置片語，不能代替句中的動詞。
in front of 表示在前面；爸爸擋住了自己的視線。
錯誤：in front of 後面通常接地點或物品，不能直接接 happy。
錯誤：yesterday 是時間，不是這裡可用的空間位置。

vocabulary.usage: 表示某個想法、感覺或事實從很早以前就存在。
options: I knew all along that you could do it.
He all along the office at nine.
I put all along inside my schoolbag.
The hotel is all along because it has a pool.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：表示從一開始就相信對方做得到。
optionExplanations: 正確：表示從一開始就相信對方做得到。
all along 表示一直，不能代替 arrived at 等動詞片語。
錯誤：all along 不是可以放進書包的物品。
all along 表示始終；有泳池無法讓旅館變成「一直」。

vocabulary.usage: 帶一個人去某個地方；也可以比喻帶某人進入新情況。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「Bring someone to」？
options: The window brings my pencil to hungry.
I bring someone to my phone with a charger.
She brings to happy me yesterday.
My sister brings me to the park on Sundays.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：bring + 人 + to + 地點，表示帶某人去某處。
optionExplanations: 錯誤：hungry 不是地點，窗戶也不會主動帶鉛筆去某處。
這裡要說替手機充電，bring someone to 無法表達這個意思。
錯誤：字序和時態都不對；要清楚說明帶誰到哪裡。
正確：bring + 人 + to + 地點，表示帶某人去某處。

advanced.note: 依本次提供的核對版材料編排；程度標籤為教學參考。

questions.meaning: 懷疑；疑慮
questions.usage: 對事情的真實性、成功機會或自己的決定感到不確定。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最自然、最正確地使用「doubt」（依上述意思）？
options: The bright yellow coat removed all doubt about the taste of soup.
The quiet library removed all doubt about tomorrow’s weather.
The new evidence removed all doubt about who had won.
The red pencil removed all doubt about the price of a house.
optionExplanations: 錯誤。外套顏色不能解決湯的味道疑問。
錯誤。安靜的圖書館無法證明天氣。
正確。新證據排除了對結果的疑慮。
錯誤。紅鉛筆不會證明房價。
questions.sourceWitness: ✅ 已在原歌詞核實（教師核對片段：doubt）。
questions.explanation: 正確。新證據排除了對結果的疑慮。

questions.meaning: 不知怎麼地；以某種未知方式
questions.usage: 知道結果發生了，但不清楚是如何做到的。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最自然、最正確地使用「somehow」（依上述意思）？
options: Somehow, our tiny team managed to win the final match.
Somehow, the clock has twelve hours written on its face.
Somehow, the train left at six because the schedule said so.
Somehow, the ice melted because we heated it all morning.
optionExplanations: 正確。小隊意外獲勝，過程令人驚訝而不明。
錯誤。普通鐘面有數字不構成未知的達成方式。
錯誤。按時刻表發車，原因十分明確。
錯誤。加熱讓冰融化，原因已明說，不需 somehow。
questions.sourceWitness: ✅ 已在原歌詞核實（教師核對片段：somehow）。
questions.explanation: 正確。小隊意外獲勝，過程令人驚訝而不明。

questions.meaning: 又更接近目標一步
questions.usage: 描述逐步推進的進展，尤其目標尚未完成。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最自然、最正確地使用「one step closer」（依上述意思）？
options: We are one step closer because the deadline moved backwards.
We are one step closer because nobody started the project.
We are one step closer because our map has lost every road.
We are one step closer after finishing the final interview.
optionExplanations: 錯誤。期限延後本身不一定表示取得進展。
錯誤。沒開始做並不更接近完成。
錯誤。地圖道路消失無助於前進。
正確。完成最後面試，離目標更近一步。
questions.sourceWitness: ✅ 已在原歌詞核實（教師核對片段：one step closer）。
questions.explanation: 正確。完成最後面試，離目標更近一步。

questions.meaning: 保持不動；（時間）彷彿靜止
questions.usage: 歌曲讓 time 擬人化；這裡測時間似乎停下的比喻義。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最自然、最正確地使用「stand still」（依上述意思）？
options: Time seemed to stand still because my watch was on sale.
Time seemed to stand still while we waited for the result.
Time seemed to stand still because the calendar was purple.
Time seemed to stand still when the clock was newly polished.
optionExplanations: 錯誤。手錶特價與時間感知無關。
正確。焦急等待時覺得時間停住，符合比喻。
錯誤。月曆顏色不支持時間靜止的感受。
錯誤。擦亮時鐘不等於時間變慢。
questions.sourceWitness: ✅ 已在原歌詞核實（教師核對片段：stands still）。
questions.explanation: 正確。焦急等待時覺得時間停住，符合比喻。

questions.meaning: 演變到這一步；最終走到這個局面
questions.usage: 歌曲中 every hour has come to this，指此前所有時刻匯聚至此；也可含無奈語氣。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最自然、最正確地使用「come to this」（依上述意思）？
options: All our hard work has come to this: a new blue stapler.
All the weather has come to this: a square wooden spoon.
Months of training have come to this: our first big performance.
Years of study have come to this: the library closes at noon.
optionExplanations: 錯誤。只有藍色訂書機難以支撐辛苦努力的重大結果。
錯誤。木湯匙與天氣沒有自然的進展連結。
正確。多月訓練最終迎來演出，語意完整。
錯誤。圖書館中午關門不代表多年學習的成果。
questions.sourceWitness: ✅ 已在原歌詞核實（教師核對片段：come to this）。
questions.explanation: 正確。多月訓練最終迎來演出，語意完整。

questions.meaning: 從一開始就；一直以來
questions.usage: 表示某件事在整段期間都是真實、已知或相信的。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最自然、最正確地使用「all along」（依上述意思）？
options: I knew all along that next winter would have twelve months.
I knew all along that she was the person behind the kind letters.
I knew all along that the sandwich had started to sing today.
I knew all along that yesterday would happen next Thursday.
optionExplanations: 錯誤。冬季並沒有十二個月，陳述失準。
正確。從一開始就知道匿名寫信人的身分，符合用法。
錯誤。三明治唱歌是荒誕情境，不能作為合理認知。
錯誤。昨天不會在下週四發生，時間自相矛盾。
questions.sourceWitness: ✅ 已在原歌詞核實（教師核對片段：all along）。
questions.explanation: 正確。從一開始就知道匿名寫信人的身分，符合用法。

questions.meaning: 奪走；使失去（抽象或具體）
questions.usage: 歌曲中指不願讓任何東西奪去重要的人事物；這題測抽象的失去。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最自然、最正確地使用「take away」（依上述意思）？
options: The accident took away his confidence, though he recovered later.
The prize took away her confidence by showing how skilled she was.
The good news took away his hope by proving the plan would work.
The compliment took away her joy by making her feel appreciated.
optionExplanations: 正確。事故使他失去信心，符合抽象用法。
錯誤。得獎通常提升信心，與被奪走相反。
錯誤。好消息證明計畫可行，通常帶來希望。
錯誤。受到讚美、感到被賞識與失去喜悅不合。
questions.sourceWitness: ✅ 已在原歌詞核實（教師核對片段：take away）。
questions.explanation: 正確。事故使他失去信心，符合抽象用法。

structure.title: 句型研習
structure.note: 依本次提供的核對版材料編排；歌曲線索與教學改寫分開呈現。

questions.word: How to + base verb（詢問做法）
questions.meaning: 詢問或提出某件事的做法；常見於標題、筆記或口語省略句。
questions.usage: 寫說明標題或簡短提出「該怎樣做」的問題時；完整問句通常用 How do I...?。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上的句型及其功能？
options: “How to clean a bike” is a story about a fish that never sees a bike.
“How to make tea” is the name of a list of places with no instructions.
The guide is called “How to grow a tomato.” It shows each step.
The guide is called “How to sleep a sandwich.” It teaches lunch.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：標題承諾教清潔單車，內容卻完全無關。
錯誤：標題表示教泡茶的方法，內容卻沒有步驟。
正確：標題提出種番茄的方法，而內容也逐步說明。
錯誤：三明治不是會睡覺的對象，動作不合理。
questions.sourceWitness: How to be brave? · supplied song PDF, lyric page(s) 2–3.
questions.example: How to open this box?
questions.explanation: 正確：標題提出種番茄的方法，而內容也逐步說明。

questions.word: How can + subject + verb...?（能力／可能性）
questions.meaning: 詢問一件事情有沒有可能做到，或可以怎樣做到。
questions.usage: 遇到障礙，想找可行方法時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上的句型及其功能？
options: How can we cross this river? There is a bridge nearby.
How can I open the box? It is already open and empty, so I must open it.
How can I find the museum? I am standing inside it and have found it.
How can I wake up? I am awake and talking to you right now.
optionExplanations: 正確：河流帶來問題，而橋提供可行方法。
錯誤：盒子已經打開，不需要再想如何打開。
錯誤：說話者已在博物館內，找尋的目標已完成。
錯誤：說話者已經醒來，問題與現況矛盾。
questions.sourceWitness: How can I love · supplied song PDF, lyric page(s) 2–3.
questions.example: How can we reach the island?
questions.explanation: 正確：河流帶來問題，而橋提供可行方法。

questions.meaning: 交代某事在甚麼時間或情況下發生。
questions.usage: 想指出一個動作與另一個時刻或情況的關係時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上的句型及其功能？
options: When the music starts, the dancers begin to move.
When the music starts, the dancers begin before any music plays, because “when” means before.
I put on my boots when I finish swimming because I need them under water.
When the lights go out, the room gets brighter because there are no other lights.
optionExplanations: 正確：音樂開始時舞者也開始動，時間關係清楚。
錯誤：when 通常表示「當……時」，不是必然「在……之前」。
錯誤：游泳完才穿靴子，卻說是為了水中使用，前後不合。
錯誤：沒有其他光源時熄燈，不會因此更亮。
questions.sourceWitness: when I’m afraid · supplied song PDF, lyric page(s) 2–3.
questions.example: I smile when my plant grows.
questions.explanation: 正確：音樂開始時舞者也開始動，時間關係清楚。

questions.word: be afraid to + base verb（害怕採取行動）
questions.meaning: 因為害怕或擔心而不敢做某個動作。
questions.usage: 想說明某人不願嘗試、接近或進行某事的心理原因時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上的句型及其功能？
options: I am afraid to speak, so I have no fear of speaking and love doing it on stage.
Mia is afraid to touch the snake, so she holds it at once without any fear.
The dog is afraid to run, so it wins every race by running without stopping.
Mia is afraid to touch the snake, so she stays behind the glass.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：前後對說話是否害怕作出相反描述。
錯誤：明說害怕，卻又說完全不怕，語意矛盾。
錯誤：害怕跑步與不斷跑步的情況沒有合理交代。
正確：因為怕蛇而保持距離，行動符合害怕的心情。
questions.sourceWitness: afraid to fall · supplied song PDF, lyric page(s) 2–3.
questions.example: The boy is afraid to dive.
questions.explanation: 正確：因為怕蛇而保持距離，行動符合害怕的心情。

questions.meaning: 連接兩個帶有差異、意外或反差的情況。
questions.usage: 想承認一件事，同時補充與預期不同的另一面時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上的句型及其功能？
options: The sky is blue, but the sky is blue.
The path was long, but it was not short.
The cookie was sweet, but it had sugar in it.
The path was long, but the children still wanted to walk.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：前後完全重複，沒有對比。
錯誤：long 與 not short 重述相同意思。
錯誤：有糖通常能解釋甜味，不是明顯轉折。
正確：路很長卻仍想繼續走，構成合理轉折。
questions.sourceWitness: But watching · supplied song PDF, lyric page(s) 2–3.
questions.example: The tent is small, but it is warm.
questions.explanation: 正確：路很長卻仍想繼續走，構成合理轉折。

questions.word: watch + object + base verb（看見完整動作）
questions.meaning: 表示觀察某人或某物做一個動作，著重動作整體。
questions.usage: 看比賽、表演或目睹某個動作時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上的句型及其功能？
options: We watched the chef cut the cake and put it on a plate.
We watched the chef to cut the cake and put it on a plate.
I watched the clock sing a song because it was hungry.
I watched the train leave, but I was asleep with my eyes closed for the whole trip.
optionExplanations: 正確：watch 後接對象及原形動詞，描述親眼看見切蛋糕。
錯誤：這個句型不在 cut 前加 to。
錯誤：一般時鐘不會因肚餓而唱歌，情境不合理。
錯誤：聲稱一直睡著，卻又說親眼看見火車離開。
questions.sourceWitness: watching you stand · supplied song PDF, lyric page(s) 2–3.
questions.example: We watched the bird fly away.
questions.explanation: 正確：watch 後接對象及原形動詞，描述親眼看見切蛋糕。

questions.meaning: 強調一組人或事物中的全部，而非部分。
questions.usage: 要指出全部物品、想法或感受時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上的句型及其功能？
options: All of our lanterns are on, so the whole street is bright.
All of my five coins are here, but I can only find two of them.
All of the chairs are ready, but no chair is ready.
All of our lanterns are on, but every lantern is off.
optionExplanations: 正確：所有燈籠都亮著，符合 all of 的全部範圍。
錯誤：聲稱五枚都在，卻只找到兩枚，內容衝突。
錯誤：全部準備好與沒有一張準備好互相矛盾。
錯誤：同時說全部亮和全部不亮。
questions.sourceWitness: All of my doubt · supplied song PDF, lyric page(s) 2–3.
questions.example: All of my tickets are wet.
questions.explanation: 正確：所有燈籠都亮著，符合 all of 的全部範圍。

questions.meaning: 表示離開某地，也可以表示感覺或問題逐漸消失。
questions.usage: 描述噪音、氣味、疼痛或麻煩結束時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上的句型及其功能？
options: The bad smell went away, so the room smelled worse than ever for the same reason.
The bad smell went away after we opened the windows.
The noise went away, and the same loud noise did not stop for one second.
The crowd went away, but every person stayed in exactly the same place.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：氣味消失與仍因此更難聞未能對應。
正確：開窗後難聞氣味消失，前後合理。
錯誤：噪音消失卻從未停止，說法矛盾。
錯誤：人群離開與每個人都沒有移動互相衝突。
questions.sourceWitness: goes away · supplied song PDF, lyric page(s) 2–3.
questions.example: The smell went away after an hour.
questions.explanation: 正確：開窗後難聞氣味消失，前後合理。

questions.meaning: 表示距離某地或達成某事又近了一小步。
questions.usage: 想鼓勵別人，說明計畫或學習有進展時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上的句型及其功能？
options: We are one step closer to our goal, but we have made no progress at all and moved backward.
We have fixed one part of the boat, so we are one step closer to sailing.
We are one step closer to the top because we walked down the hill all day.
We are one step closer to finishing the picture because we erased all our work.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：宣稱更接近目標，卻又說只在倒退。
正確：修好一個部分代表完成出海準備又前進一步。
錯誤：一直往山下走，通常不會更接近山頂。
錯誤：把所有已完成的畫擦掉，通常不是接近完成。
questions.sourceWitness: One step closer · supplied song PDF, lyric page(s) 2–3.
questions.example: We are one step closer to the finish line.
questions.explanation: 正確：修好一個部分代表完成出海準備又前進一步。

questions.word: present perfect: have/has + past participle（過去連到現在）
questions.meaning: 強調過去發生的事情與現在仍有關聯。
questions.usage: 想說明到現在為止已經完成、經歷或產生的改變時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上的句型及其功能？
options: I have lost my hat, so it is still on my head and I never lost it.
We have cleaned the beach, but we have not done any cleaning at all.
The artist has finished the picture, but she has not started drawing it yet.
The artist has finished the picture, so we can see it now.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：說遺失帽子卻又說從未遺失。
錯誤：宣稱已清潔與完全沒有清潔矛盾。
錯誤：已完成與尚未開始不能同時成立。
正確：已完成的畫現在可以觀看，結果與現在相連。
questions.sourceWitness: Time has brought · supplied song PDF, lyric page(s) 2–3.
questions.example: The team has finished the bridge.
questions.explanation: 正確：已完成的畫現在可以觀看，結果與現在相連。

questions.word: have/has + past participle + for + duration（持續多久）
questions.meaning: 表示一種情況從過去延續到現在，並交代持續時間。
questions.usage: 說住了多久、認識了多久或某個狀態持續了多久時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上的句型及其功能？
options: The family has lived near the lake for five years, but they arrived there for the first time today.
The family has lived near the lake for five years and still lives there.
I have worked at this shop for ten years, but I was born last year.
She has known him for four years, but they met for the first time this morning.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：住了五年與今天才首次抵達互相矛盾。
正確：五年前開始居住而現在仍住在湖邊，符合持續用法。
錯誤：一歲的人不可能已工作十年。
錯誤：認識四年與今天首次相識互相衝突。
questions.sourceWitness: I have loved ... for · supplied song PDF, lyric page(s) 2–3.
questions.example: They have lived here for six years.
questions.explanation: 正確：五年前開始居住而現在仍住在湖邊，符合持續用法。

questions.word: for + quantity + more（再多一段／一些）
questions.meaning: 表示在原本數量或時間之外再增加一些。
questions.usage: 想表達延長停留、等待或再做幾次時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上的句型及其功能？
options: We need three more chairs, but we already have all the chairs we need and need none.
We will stay for one more hour, which means we must leave one hour ago.
The fair is fun, so we will stay for one more hour.
I asked for two more tickets, so I asked for zero extra tickets.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：需要再加三張與完全不需要矛盾。
錯誤：增加一小時不代表一小時前已離開。
正確：希望再逗留一小時，more 清楚表示額外增加。
錯誤：two more 與 zero extra 意思相反。
questions.sourceWitness: a thousand more · supplied song PDF, lyric page(s) 2–3.
questions.example: We can stay for two more days.
questions.explanation: 正確：希望再逗留一小時，more 清楚表示額外增加。

questions.word: will + base verb（未來承諾／決定）
questions.meaning: 表達對未來的承諾、決定或預測。
questions.usage: 答應幫忙、決定下一步或說明未來打算時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上的句型及其功能？
options: I will bring the maps tomorrow, but I brought them tomorrow yesterday.
I will visit the farm next week, and next week was last month.
I will send you the photo tonight, but I promise never to send it at any time.
I will bring the maps tomorrow, so we can plan our walk.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：把 tomorrow 當成昨天發生的時間。
錯誤：next week 不可能等於上個月。
錯誤：答應今晚傳照片與永遠不傳的承諾衝突。
正確：說話者承諾明天帶地圖，時間與計畫一致。
questions.sourceWitness: I will be brave · supplied song PDF, lyric page(s) 2–3.
questions.example: I will help you tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 正確：說話者承諾明天帶地圖，時間與計畫一致。

questions.meaning: 提醒、要求或勸告別人不要做某件事。
questions.usage: 為安全、禮貌或避免犯錯而提出禁止或提醒時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上的句型及其功能？
options: Don’t running near the pool; walk slowly.
Don’t open the gate, so please open it now.
Don’t feed the birds here; the sign says they need their own food.
Don’t to feed the birds here; the sign says stop.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：Don’t 後面應接 run，而不是 running。
錯誤：同時叫人不要開門又立即開門，指示矛盾。
正確：禁止餵鳥的提醒配合告示和原因。
錯誤：否定祈使句用原形 feed，不能加 to。
questions.sourceWitness: don’t be afraid · supplied song PDF, lyric page(s) 2–3.
questions.example: Don’t touch the wet paint.
questions.explanation: 正確：禁止餵鳥的提醒配合告示和原因。

questions.meaning: 描述某人或某物所處的狀態或特質。
questions.usage: 直接說明人、物或情況是怎樣時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上的句型及其功能？
options: The little horse is calm and waits quietly beside its owner.
The little horse is asleep, and it is running and jumping at the same moment.
The lake is dry, so it is full of deep water everywhere.
The hall is empty, and three hundred guests are sitting inside it.
optionExplanations: 正確：安靜等待符合 calm 的狀態。
錯誤：睡著與同時跑跳的敘述互相矛盾。
錯誤：乾涸與處處深水互相衝突。
錯誤：空無一人與坐滿賓客不一致。
questions.sourceWitness: I will be brave · supplied song PDF, lyric page(s) 2–3.
questions.example: The climber is brave.
questions.explanation: 正確：安靜等待符合 calm 的狀態。

questions.word: let + object + base verb（允許／讓某人做）
questions.meaning: 表示讓某人做某事，let 後面不用 to。
questions.usage: 描述允許、阻止（not let）或給別人機會採取行動時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上的句型及其功能？
options: The keeper let the penguins to swim after checking the water.
The keeper let the penguins swimming after checking the water.
The keeper let the penguins swim after checking the water.
The keeper did not let anyone enter, so everyone entered with his permission.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：let someone do 不用 to swim。
錯誤：此句型應用 swim，不用 swimming。
正確：let 後直接接對象與原形動詞 swim。
錯誤：禁止入內與所有人獲准入內互相矛盾。
questions.sourceWitness: let anything take away · supplied song PDF, lyric page(s) 2–3.
questions.example: The coach let us rest.
questions.explanation: 正確：let 後直接接對象與原形動詞 swim。

questions.word: not let + object + base verb（決定不讓）
questions.meaning: 強調決心阻止某人或某件事帶來某種結果。
questions.usage: 想保護目標、提出決心或設下限制時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上的句型及其功能？
options: We will not let one small mistake stop our show; we will try again.
I will not let the rain stop our picnic, so I have cancelled it only because of rain.
They will not let the cold stop the race, so the race was cancelled only because it was cold.
We will not let one small mistake stop our show, so we have stopped the show forever because of it.
optionExplanations: 正確：有錯仍繼續表演，符合不讓小錯阻礙的決心。
錯誤：說不讓下雨影響，卻只因下雨取消活動。
錯誤：宣稱不受寒冷影響，卻正因寒冷取消比賽。
錯誤：說不讓錯誤阻止，卻因此永遠停演。
questions.sourceWitness: will not let anything · supplied song PDF, lyric page(s) 2–3.
questions.example: I will not let the wind ruin our game.
questions.explanation: 正確：有錯仍繼續表演，符合不讓小錯阻礙的決心。

questions.meaning: 表示任何一件事或任何事物；作主詞時通常視為單數。
questions.usage: 強調沒有例外，或不讓任何事情發生時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上的句型及其功能？
options: You can choose anything, but you may not choose any item at all.
Anything in this box are broken, so we cannot use it.
Nothing in this bag is mine, so you can take anything you need.
I did not bring anything, but I brought five things and nothing else.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：說任選卻又禁止選任何一樣，語意衝突。
錯誤：anything 作主詞要用 is，而不是 are。
正確：anything 指袋中的任意物品，使用語境合理。
錯誤：說沒帶任何東西，卻又說帶了五樣。
questions.sourceWitness: anything take away · supplied song PDF, lyric page(s) 2–3.
questions.example: Anything is possible in this game.

questions.meaning: 把某物從原來的地方移走。
questions.usage: 清理、搬走或要求某物不要留在眼前時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上的句型及其功能？
options: After the market, workers took the boxes away, but every box stayed there.
The chef took the soup away by leaving it in exactly the same place.
After the market, workers took the empty boxes away.
The farmer took the old gate away, so the same gate was still in its old place.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：已搬走與全部留下互相矛盾。
錯誤：原封不動留在原處並非拿走。
正確：工作人員把空箱搬離，符合 take ... away。
錯誤：宣稱搬走卻仍在原位，情況不一致。
questions.sourceWitness: take away · supplied song PDF, lyric page(s) 2–3.
questions.example: Please take the broken chair away.
questions.explanation: 正確：工作人員把空箱搬離，符合 take ... away。

questions.meaning: 把「……的事情／東西」整體當作名詞使用。
questions.usage: 想強調自己需要、看見或想知道的事物時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上的句型及其功能？
options: What I want is some water, but I do not want any water at all.
What she found was an empty nest, but she found nothing and saw no nest.
What we need are a ladder because the window is very high.
What we need is a ladder because the window is very high.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：說想要水卻又說完全不想要。
錯誤：聲稱發現鳥巢又說甚麼也沒發現。
錯誤：以單一需求作整體主詞時，這裡應用 is。
正確：What we need 作整體主詞，後面清楚指出所需物品。
questions.sourceWitness: What’s standing · supplied song PDF, lyric page(s) 2–3.
questions.example: What we need is a dry map.
questions.explanation: 正確：What we need 作整體主詞，後面清楚指出所需物品。

questions.meaning: 表示目前正在進行的活動或暫時情況。
questions.usage: 描述眼前正在發生的動作時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上的句型及其功能？
options: The robot is moving now, but it has never moved and is completely still now.
The dancers are practising now, but practice will not start until next year.
The baby is sleeping now, and is playing football awake at this exact moment.
The robot is moving across the floor now, so we must stay clear.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：同一時間說正在移動又完全靜止。
錯誤：目前正在練習與明年才開始互相衝突。
錯誤：同一時刻睡著與清醒踢球不合常理。
正確：機械人現在移動，提醒旁人保持距離合理。
questions.sourceWitness: What’s standing · supplied song PDF, lyric page(s) 2–3.
questions.example: The robot is carrying a small box.
questions.explanation: 正確：機械人現在移動，提醒旁人保持距離合理。

questions.meaning: 表示位置在另一個人或物的前方。
questions.usage: 描述座位、隊伍、路線或物品位置時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上的句型及其功能？
options: The guide stood in front of the group so everyone could see her.
The guide stood in front of the group, directly behind every person in it.
The sign is in front of the shop, but it is ten streets behind the shop.
I stood in front of the mirror, but the mirror was far away in another country.
optionExplanations: 正確：領隊在隊伍前方，方便大家看見。
錯誤：同時在隊伍前與每人身後，位置矛盾。
錯誤：招牌不能同時在店前與相隔十條街的店後。
錯誤：鏡子遠在另一國，難以同時站在它前面。
questions.sourceWitness: in front of me · supplied song PDF, lyric page(s) 2–3.
questions.example: The drummer is in front of the stage.
questions.explanation: 正確：領隊在隊伍前方，方便大家看見。

questions.meaning: 逐一指整組中的每個成員；名詞通常用單數。
questions.usage: 想強調每次、每人、每一天或每個物品都包括在內時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上的句型及其功能？
options: Every child got a gift, but half of the children got no gift.
Every player has a number on the back of their shirt.
Every players has a number on the back of their shirt.
Every boat have a light, and each boat has one light.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：每個孩子都收到與一半沒有收到相矛盾。
正確：every 後接單數 player，has 也與主詞一致。
錯誤：every 後面的可數名詞通常用單數 player。
錯誤：every boat 作單數主詞，應用 has。
questions.sourceWitness: Every hour · supplied song PDF, lyric page(s) 2–3.
questions.example: Every window has a blue star.
questions.explanation: 正確：every 後接單數 player，has 也與主詞一致。

questions.word: come to + noun（走到某個階段／結果）
questions.meaning: 表示一件事情經過發展後到達某個結果或階段。
questions.usage: 回顧活動如何走到現在這一步時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上的句型及其功能？
options: The show has come to its final song, and the first song has not begun yet.
After months of work, our new garden has come to life.
Our trip has come to an end, so it has not started yet and has no end.
The long wait has come to an end, but we still have exactly the same wait ahead.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：已到最後一首但第一首尚未開始，情況不合。
正確：花園經過數月努力終於有生氣，表示發展的結果。
錯誤：已到終點與尚未開始並列而未作合理解釋。
錯誤：等待已結束卻仍完全未結束，語意衝突。
questions.sourceWitness: has come to this · supplied song PDF, lyric page(s) 2–3.
questions.example: Our long trip has come to an end.
questions.explanation: 正確：花園經過數月努力終於有生氣，表示發展的結果。

questions.meaning: 從很早以前到現在或某個後來時點一直如此。
questions.usage: 想說自己早就知道、相信或懷疑某事時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上的句型及其功能？
options: All along, Dad knew where the kite was, but he learned its place only just now and had no idea before.
All along, I thought the museum was closed, but I never had that thought until this second.
All along, Dad knew where the missing kite was; he put it in the shed.
All along, she had the key, but she did not get it until tomorrow for the first time.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：一直知道與剛剛才第一次知道相反。
錯誤：一直這樣想與此刻才首次想到互相矛盾。
正確：爸爸早已把風箏收起，因而一直知道位置。
錯誤：一直持有與直到明天才取得不能同時成立。
questions.sourceWitness: all along · supplied song PDF, lyric page(s) 2–3.
questions.example: All along, I knew the answer.
questions.explanation: 正確：爸爸早已把風箏收起，因而一直知道位置。

questions.meaning: 說明某人相信某個判斷或結果。
questions.usage: 表達信心、希望或對未知結果的想法時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上的句型及其功能？
options: I believed the bridge was safe, but I was certain it was not safe at that same time.
I believed our small boat could reach the island because the sea was calm.
She believes her dog can talk, because it says words every day, although it never makes a sound.
I believed the box was empty because I looked inside and saw it was full of toys.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：同時完全相信安全又確定不安全，沒有合理區分。
正確：平靜海面支持對小船能到島上的信心。
錯誤：以每天說話作證據，卻又說從未發聲。
錯誤：親眼看到滿盒玩具，卻用它支持「盒子是空的」。
questions.sourceWitness: I believed · supplied song PDF, lyric page(s) 2–3.
questions.example: I believed that the plan would work.
questions.explanation: 正確：平靜海面支持對小船能到島上的信心。

questions.word: would + base verb（過去視角的未來）
questions.meaning: 從過去某一刻看，談當時尚未發生的將來事情。
questions.usage: 轉述以前的希望、承諾或預測時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上的句型及其功能？
options: Yesterday, I knew the train would arrive today, but today happened ten years ago.
She said yesterday that the light would turn on tonight, but she said it after tonight ended next week.
Last Monday, I believed the seeds would grow, and Monday is tomorrow for the first time.
Last Monday, I believed the seeds would grow, and today I can see small leaves.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：昨天、今天與十年前的時間設定互相衝突。
錯誤：昨天的說話時間不可能發生在下星期今晚結束之後。
錯誤：把已過的星期一又說成第一次的明天。
正確：星期一的預測指向後來的發芽，時間順序清楚。
questions.sourceWitness: I would find you · supplied song PDF, lyric page(s) 2–3.
questions.example: I knew the train would arrive soon.
questions.explanation: 正確：星期一的預測指向後來的發芽，時間順序清楚。

questions.meaning: 將某人或某物帶到另一人身邊或某個地方。
questions.usage: 說明東西如何到達、由誰帶來或交給誰時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上的句型及其功能？
options: The baker brought fresh bread to the market before sunrise.
The baker brought bread to the market, but the bread never left his kitchen.
She brought the map to us, but nobody carried or sent any map to us.
The wind brought the boat to shore, but the boat stayed far out at sea.
optionExplanations: 正確：麵包師把麵包送到市場，目的地清楚。
錯誤：已帶到市場與從未離開廚房互相矛盾。
錯誤：說帶來地圖又說沒有人送來任何地圖。
錯誤：說船已靠岸卻仍在遠海，結果矛盾。
questions.sourceWitness: has brought your heart to me · supplied song PDF, lyric page(s) 2–3.
questions.cue: has brought your heart to me
questions.example: The postman brought a letter to our house.
questions.explanation: 正確：麵包師把麵包送到市場，目的地清楚。

questions.word: verb + -ing adjunct（同時進行／背景動作）
questions.meaning: 用 -ing 片語補充主要動作發生時的伴隨情況。
questions.usage: 想在一句話中描寫邊走邊做、邊等邊看等情況時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上的句型及其功能？
options: He cooked dinner, sleeping deeply in a bed in another town at the same time.
The children waited outside, holding paper stars for the show.
She watched the race, looking at nothing because she had never gone near it.
The children waited outside, holding stars that they had left at home and never touched.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：在另一城鎮熟睡與同時親自煮晚餐不合常理。
正確：等候時手持紙星星，-ing 交代伴隨動作。
錯誤：聲稱觀看比賽，卻完全沒有接近或看見比賽。
錯誤：星星一直留在家中而未碰過，不可能同時拿著。
questions.sourceWitness: every day waiting for you · supplied song PDF, lyric page(s) 2–3.
questions.example: She walked home holding a red balloon.
questions.explanation: 正確：等候時手持紙星星，-ing 交代伴隨動作。
